note: rustre-loader-java provides JVM class/JAR parsing (CAFEBABE header, constant pool, descriptors, bytecode disassembly, manifest parsing, security findings). The MCP server exposes only ONE related tool: analysis_disasm_at_path_jvm (registered in crates/rustre-mcp-tools/src/wire_tools.rs around line 7531). There are no MCP tools for is_class/is_jar, descriptor parsing (parse_field/parse_method), constant pool inspection, manifest parsing, or security analysis. The MCP disasm tool also requires a recognized container format (it routed through the loader registry which rejected raw bytecode with 'no registered loader can handle format: Unknown'), so even the one available tool cannot disassemble the same raw bytecode buffers the validator targets.
